name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
target_audience: Small and Marginal Farmers owning cultivable land
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 credited directly into the farmer's Aadhaar-linked bank account.
application_process: Self-register online at pmkisan.gov.in or through local Village Administrative Officer (VAO) / Common Service Centre (CSC).

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
target_audience: Small and Marginal Farmers aged 18 to 40 years
benefits: Assured life-long pension of ₹3,000 per month on attaining age 60. Monthly contribution ₹55 to ₹200 matched 50:50 by Central Government.
documents_required: Savings Bank Account / PM-KISAN Bank Account
application_process: Register online at pmkmy.gov.in or visit any Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and Bank Passbook.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) & Modified Interest Subvention
target_audience: Owner-cultivators, Tenant farmers, Sharecroppers, PACS members
benefit_summary: Loans up to ₹3 Lakh @ 4% subsidized interest
benefits: Short-term crop production loan up to ₹3,00,000 at effective 4% interest per annum with prompt repayment (3% subvention). No collateral required for loans up to ₹1,60,000.
application_process: Apply at any Nationalized Bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or local Primary Agricultural Credit Society (PACS).

name: PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop (Micro Irrigation Drip & Sprinkler)
state_scope: Central / Tamil Nadu (100% Subsidy for SF/MF in TN)
target_audience: Small, Marginal & Other Farmers cultivating row/horticulture crops
benefit_summary: 100% Free Drip Setup in TN (75% for others)
benefits: 100% subsidy for Small & Marginal Farmers (up to 5 acres) in Tamil Nadu (60% Central + 40% State top-up) and 75% for other farmers for installing Drip / Sprinkler systems.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card and Soil/Water Test Report
application_process: Apply through the Block Agricultural Engineering / Horticulture Department or via TN Uzhavan Mobile App.

name: PM-KUSUM (Component B & C Solar Agriculture Pumps)
target_audience: Farmers with functional borewells/wells without grid electrical power
benefit_summary: Up to 60% - 70% Subsidy on Solar Pumps
benefits: 60% to 70% capital subsidy (30% Central + 40% State) for setting up 3 HP to 10 HP off-grid solar agriculture pumps and solarization of existing grid-connected agriculture pumps.
application_process: Register online via state renewable energy agencies (TEDA in Tamil Nadu: teda.in) or MNRE portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
target_audience: All farmers growing notified crops (Paddy, Cotton, Maize, Pulses, Horticulture)
benefit_summary: Full crop loss payout (1.5% - 2% nominal premium)
benefits: Comprehensive insurance coverage against non-preventable natural calamities (drought, flood, cyclones, pests, unseasonal rain). Farmer pays only 2% premium for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for Horticulture.
documents_required: Sowing Certificate from Village Administrative Officer (VAO)
application_process: Apply via PMFBY portal (pmfby.gov.in), PACS, Nationalized Bank branch, or CSC within the notified crop cutoff dates.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
benefit_summary: 3% Interest Subvention on loans up to ₹2 Crore
benefits: Medium to long-term debt financing for post-harvest management infrastructure (warehouses, cold storage, silos, sorting/grading units, solar dryers) with 3% interest subvention for up to 7 years.
application_process: Register on the national portal agriinfra.dac.gov.in and submit Detailed Project Report (DPR).

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
target_audience: Farmers, SC/ST, Women farmers, Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs)
benefits: 40% to 50% direct subsidy for individual farmers purchasing Tractors, Power Tillers, Rotavators, Combine Harvesters, Drone Sprayers, and up to 80% grant for establishing Custom Hiring Centers (CHC).
application_process: Apply online at agrimachinery.nic.in or submit through Assistant Executive Engineer (AED) office.

name: Soil Health Card (SHC) & Balanced Fertilization Scheme
benefits: Free comprehensive soil testing (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, Organic Carbon) with customized dosage charts for fertilizers and bio-manures every 2 years.
documents_required: Farmer Aadhaar and Survey Number details
application_process: Contact the local Agricultural Extension Officer (AEO) or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) to request field soil collection.

name: Tamil Nadu Free Agricultural Electricity Scheme (TANGEDCO)
target_audience: Farmers with registered agricultural borewell or open well pump sets in Tamil Nadu
benefits: Completely free electricity (zero tariff) for operating electric pump sets used exclusively for crop cultivation and irrigation across Tamil Nadu.
application_process: Submit application to Assistant Engineer, TANGEDCO local section office or apply via Uzhavan App.

name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM) Subsidized Seed Minikits
target_audience: Farmers cultivating Pulses (Blackgram, Greengram, Redgram) and Oilseeds (Groundnut, Sesame)
benefits: Distribution of certified high-yielding hybrid seed minikits at 50% to 100% subsidy along with bio-fertilizers (Rhizobium, Phosphobacteria) to enhance soil nitrogen fixation.
application_process: Collect directly from the local Agricultural Extension Centre (AEC) / Block Department of Agriculture.

name: National Fertilizer Subsidy & Capped Statutory MRP Scheme
target_audience: All Indian Farmers purchasing through POS machines in PACS/Retailers
benefits: Government absorbs international price volatility by releasing direct manufacturer subsidies. Neem Coated Urea capped at ₹266.50 per 45kg bag; DAP, MOP, and Complex fertilizers provided at subsidized rates.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card (authenticated via Biometric POS at fertilizer store)
application_process: Purchase directly at any Primary Agricultural Cooperative Society (PACS) or authorized fertilizer dealer using Aadhaar biometric POS.

name: State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF) Agricultural Input Subsidy
target_audience: Farmers suffering 33% or higher crop loss due to drought, flood, hail, or cyclone
benefits: Direct financial relief assistance transferred into bank accounts for crop loss: ₹8,500/hectare for rainfed crops, ₹17,000/hectare for assured irrigated crops, and ₹22,500/hectare for perennial horticulture crops.
documents_required: Joint field inspection report by Revenue & Agri departments
application_process: Enumerated automatically by District Collectorate and VAO field survey following declared disaster notifications.

name: Kalaignarin All Village Integrated Agricultural Development Programme
target_audience: Farmers in selected Village Panchayats across Tamil Nadu
benefit_summary: Free seed kits, coconut saplings & drip subsidies
benefits: Comprehensive state support: reclamation of fallow lands, distribution of certified seeds, coconut seedlings, horticultural minikits, desilting farm ponds, and community solar pump installations.
application_process: Register via TN Uzhavan App or contact local Block Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA) office.

name: Animal Husbandry & Dairy Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF)
target_audience: Dairy farmers, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), Cooperative societies
benefits: Financial support for establishing dairy processing, meat processing, animal feed plants, and cattle breed improvement units with 3% interest subvention for up to 8 years.
documents_required: Land / lease document for plant setup
application_process: Apply online at ahidf.udyamimitra.in portal with project proposal.
